viewer.label: Slant · inward held catch
viewer.definition: Slant: take two sustained steps, then cut approximately 45° inward. Inward is right in this formation.
viewer.notes: Receiver starts two yards beside the midfield machine. Two sustained footfall onsets precede the inward cut: 42.49° early heading change versus 14.65° with zero steering. The route later curves to about 59°, so the intended 45° exit remains imperfect. Running before the receive transitions to forward walking. The 8.779 m free-flight pass produces 186 ms of short control at 0.375 m/s relative speed, then a 2.795 s continuous two-hand hold through 9.5 s. No floor or nonhand body support. No running phases at contact or completed stop. Pretrained locomotion and scripted RGB-D grip; exact reruns and independent checks archived.
